digest.component_or_area: git fetch timeout handling across multiple call sites
propositions: Three 300-second network git fetch call sites (review_bot gerrit_client, opcert_service workspace, and _commands init) lack low-speed throughput abort logic and are exposed to full timeout stalls like the one fixed in 12e4
The stall abort seam built by 12e4 (stall_abort_args() and is_stall_abort()) is module-public and reusable across sites without snapshot-specific state

Each of the three sites must be armed to pass http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime options via git_fetch.stall_abort_args() to enable sub-10s abort on byte-starved transfers instead of 300s wall-clock timeout
Tests must discriminate between zero-byte remotes (abort as stall) and dribbling remotes above the throughput floor (do not abort) at each call site
Module-size constraints required moving the arming logic down to _init_probe.run_bounded_git seam rather than init.py to stay within the 800 LOC gate
